name: Notebooks v1
evidence: Managed notebooks are deprecated in favor of Vertex AI Workbench Instances. They were scheduled for retirement on January 16, 2024. [Vertex AI Release Notes (January 16, 2024)](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/release-notes#January_16_2024)

name: Parallelstore
evidence: Parallelstore high-performance SSD scratch storage has been discontinued and removed from the active client libraries. [Google Cloud C++ Client Libraries Changelog](https://googleapis.github.io/google-cloud-cpp/CHANGELOG.html#removed-libraries)

name: Blockchain Node Engine
evidence: Google Cloud retired the entire Blockchain Node Engine service on September 10, 2024. [Blockchain Node Engine Release Notes](https://cloud.google.com/blockchain-node-engine/docs/release-notes)

name: Google Tables
evidence: Google Tables was officially closed and shut down as a standalone service. [Table Beta Updates & FAQ](https://support.google.com/area120-tables/answer/10831919)

name: Data Labeling Service
evidence: The standalone Data Labeling Service is deprecated. Users are directed to use the Vertex AI console to label datasets instead. [Data Labeling Service Deprecation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/deprecations)

name: BeyondCorp Enterprise client connector
evidence: The BeyondCorp Enterprise client connector was deprecated on March 15, 2023, and was shut down on December 31, 2023. [BeyondCorpClientConnectorService](https://docs.cloud.google.com/beyondcorp/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.clientConnectorServices), [BeyondCorpClientGateway](https://docs.cloud.google.com/beyondcorp/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.clientGateways)

name: Cloud IoT Core
evidence: Google Cloud IoT Core service was retired on August 16, 2023. [Cloud IoT Core Resource Hub](https://docs.cloud.google.com/eventarc/docs/event-types#triggers-events)
